    // Helper function to check if a string is good (balanced parentheses)
    method is_good(s: string) returns (is_balanced: bool)
        requires |s| >= 0
        ensures is_balanced == (count_open(s) == count_close(s) && is_balanced_sequence(s))
    
    // Helper function to count open parentheses
    method count_open(s: string) returns (count: int)
        requires |s| >= 0
        ensures count >= 0 && count == Sum(i | 0 <= i < |s| && s[i] == '(')
    
    // Helper function to count close parentheses
    method count_close(s: string) returns (count: int)
        requires |s| >= 0
        ensures count >= 0 && count == Sum(i | 0 <= i < |s| && s[i] == ')')

    // Helper function to check if the sequence of parentheses is balanced
    method is_balanced_sequence(s: string) returns (balanced: bool)
        requires |s| >= 0
        ensures balanced == (forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| ==> count_open_prefix(s, i) >= count_close_prefix(s, i))

    // Helper function to count open parentheses up to a given index
    method count_open_prefix(s: string, index: int) returns (count: int)
        requires 0 <= index < |s|
        ensures count == Sum(i | 0 <= i <= index && s[i] == '(')

    // Helper function to count close parentheses up to a given index
    method count_close_prefix(s: string, index: int) returns (count: int)
        requires 0 <= index < |s|
        ensures count == Sum(i | 0 <= i <= index && s[i] == ')')
